description: A shell script for testing 'git pack-redundant' functionality, including setup, creating commits and packs, and verifying redundant pack detection in git repositories.

methods.name: create_commits_in
methods.description: Creates commits in a specified git repository, assigning each commit's oid to a variable.

methods.name: create_pack_in
methods.description: Creates a pack in a specified repository and assigns its id to a variable.

methods.name: format_packfiles
methods.description: Formats pack file names for comparison.
